en: She was determined on taking the risk.
cn: 她决意要冒这次风险。

en: Hard work is certain to bring progress.
cn: 努力工作一定会带来进步。

en: It is likely to rain; look at the dark cloud.
cn: 天气很有可能会下雨，看那片乌云。

en: The trend is unlikely to change soon.
cn: 这种趋势短期内不太可能会改变。

en: Be sure to double-check the files.
cn: 务必再次核对一下那些文件。

en: He is always ready to help friends.
cn: 他总是非常乐意帮助朋友。

en: The cat was quick to catch the mouse.
cn: 那只猫迅速抓住了老鼠。

en: The firm was slow to adjust to trends.
cn: 这家公司在顺应趋势做出调整方面反应迟缓。

en: Tired drivers are prone to making mistakes.
cn: 疲劳驾驶者容易犯错。

en: Be careful to check every detail.
cn: 注意检查每一个细节。

en: I was fortunate to meet the master in Yokohama.
cn: 我很幸运能在横滨见到这位大师。

en: We are proud to serve the research team.
cn: 我们为能给这个研究团队服务而感到自豪。

en: In terms of natural resources, the country is rich.
cn: 在自然资源方面，这个国家很富有。

p: in contrast to / in contrast with
en: In contrast to her sister, she is very outgoing.
cn: 与她姐姐相比，她非常外向。

en: In comparison with him, I am still a beginner.
cn: 与他相比，我依然只是个初学者。

en: In addition to milk, we need to buy some bread.
cn: 除了牛奶之外，我们还需要买点面包。

en: Most students are in favor of the new strategy.
cn: 大多数学生都赞成这项新策略。

en: A monument was built in honor of the hero.
cn: 建造了一座纪念碑以纪念这位英雄。

en: In light of recent facts, we must adjust the plan.
cn: 鉴于最近的事实，我们必须调整计划。

en: The old wooden school building is in need of repair.
cn: 这栋老旧的学校木质建筑需要修缮。

en: He attended the meeting in place of his boss.
cn: 他代替他的老板参加了会议。

en: The firm adjusted prices in response to market trends.
cn: 公司调整了价格以回应市场趋势。

en: They traveled west in search of gold and wealth.
cn: 他们一路向西寻找黄金和财富。

en: They went out in spite of the heavy rain.
cn: 尽管下着大雨，他们还是出去了。

en: He remained calm even in the face of great danger.
cn: 即使面对巨大的危险，他依然保持冷静。

en: On behalf of the whole team, I accept this award.
cn: 我代表全队接受这个奖项。

en: We made decisions on the basis of data.
cn: 我们根据数据做出了决策。

en: The match was delayed as a result of heavy snow.
cn: 由于大雪，比赛推迟了。

en: The small boat was at the mercy of the sea.
cn: 小船任凭波涛汹涌的大海摆布。

en: He saved the drowning boy at the risk of his life.
cn: 他冒着生命危险救了那个溺水的男孩。

en: He lifted the box by means of a rope.
cn: 他借助绳子把箱子吊了起来。

en: Please stop arguing for the sake of the kids.
cn: 为了孩子，请别吵了。

en: I have some questions with regard to that contract.
cn: 关于那份合同，我有一些问题。

en: He learned coding with a view to starting a tech firm.
cn: 他学习编程是为了开一家科技公司。

en: He won the speech match by virtue of his patience.
cn: 他凭借着耐心赢得了演讲比赛。

en: He built up the firm at the expense of his health.
cn: 他以牺牲健康为代价建立起了这家公司。

en: In case of fire, use the stairs instead of the elevator.
cn: 万一发生火灾，走楼梯，不要坐电梯。

en: We should act in accordance with the safety rules.
cn: 我们应当根据安全规则行事。

en: Your salary will rise in proportion to your profit contribution.
cn: 你的薪资会与你的利润贡献成比例增长。

en: The bus was in collision with a truck.
cn: 那辆公交车与一辆卡车相撞了。

en: In common with many youth, he loves digital games.
cn: 和许多年轻人一样，他喜欢电子游戏。

en: The layout must be in conformity with official rules.
cn: 页面布局必须符合官方规则。

en: Apart from a few typos, the essay is nearly perfect.
cn: 除几处拼写错误外，这篇文章近乎完美。

en: The club welcomes everyone regardless of age or gender.
cn: 俱乐部欢迎任何人，不管年龄或性别。

en: According to the map, the station is around the corner.
cn: 根据地图，车站就在拐角处。

en: The delay was due to traffic jam.
cn: 这次延误是由于交通堵塞引起的。

en: Thanks to your timely aid, we won.
cn: 多亏你及时的援助，我们赢了。

en: As for me, I prefer the first option.
cn: 至于我，我更喜欢第一个方案。

en: Let's use real tea instead of instant coffee.
cn: 让我们用真正的茶来代替速溶咖啡吧。

en: We stayed at home because of the cold, rainy weather.
cn: 因为天气阴冷多雨，我们待在家里。

en: Owing to economic issues, the store closed.
cn: 由于经济问题，那家商店关闭了。

en: The hall can hold up to one thousand people.
cn: 这个大厅最多可容纳一千人。

en: He finished the work ahead of schedule.
cn: 他提前完成了工作。

en: The room was empty except for an old wooden desk.
cn: 房间里除了一张老旧的木桌外空无一物。

en: But for your help, I would have failed the exam.
cn: 要不是你的帮助，我这次考试就挂了。

en: He sent the gift along with a letter.
cn: 他把礼物连同一封热情的信一起寄了过去。

en: Contrary to expectations, the strategy was successful.
cn: 与预期相反，这个策略取得了成功。

en: All of a sudden, the storm started.
cn: 突然之间，暴风雨倾盆而下。

en: I found the historical document by accident.
cn: 我偶然发现了这份历史文献。

en: We met each other by chance in Yokohama yesterday.
cn: 我们昨天在横滨偶然相遇了。

en: He broke the vase on purpose.
cn: 他故意打碎了花瓶。

en: Please explain the procedure in detail.
cn: 请详细说明这个流程。

en: In reality, the plan is hard to execute.
cn: 实际上，这个计划很难执行。

en: In general, the plan is reasonable.
cn: 总的来说，这个计划是合理的。

en: I love sports, football in particular.
cn: 我热爱体育运动，尤其是足球。

en: In brief, the whole research project failed completely.
cn: 简言之，整个研究项目彻底失败了。

en: In a word, he is a trustworthy professional partner.
cn: 总之，他是一个值得信赖的专业合作伙伴。

en: All in all, it was a great success.
cn: 总而言之，非常成功。

en: On the whole, the market trend is good.
cn: 总的来说，市场趋势是好的。

en: It is not cheap; on the contrary, it costs a lot.
cn: 它一点也不便宜；相反，它成本很高。

en: The scheme will pay off in the long run.
cn: 这个方案从长远来看是合算的。

en: All their efforts were in vain.
cn: 他们所有的努力都白费了。

en: On average, the team solves ten errors a day.
cn: 平均而言，团队每天解决十个错误。

m: 务必;想方设法;当然可以
en: Finish the task by all means.
cn: 务必想办法完成这项任务。

en: It is by no means easy to learn coding.
cn: 学习编程绝非易事。

en: We returned home by way of the central park.
cn: 我们经由中央公园回了家。

en: Up to now, everything has gone well.
cn: 到目前为止，一切进展顺利。

en: You should book the room in advance.
cn: 你应该提前预订房间。

en: He left the office room in a hurry yesterday.
cn: 他昨天匆匆忙忙地离开了办公室。

en: Take an umbrella with you in case it rains.
cn: 带把伞吧，以防下雨。

en: Please arrive for the test on time.
cn: 请准时参加考试。

en: He was out of breath after the run.
cn: 在剧烈奔跑之后，他喘不上气来。

en: Without question, his research was successful.
cn: 毫无疑问，他的研究取得了成功。

en: Traveling to Europe now is out of the question.
cn: 现在去欧洲旅游是不可能的。

en: They prefer to talk face to face rather than via chat.
cn: 比起聊天软件，他们更喜欢面对面交谈。

en: First of all, load the data files.
cn: 首先，加载数据文件。

en: You had better leave now.
cn: 你最好现在就离开。

en: Sooner or later, you will find the hidden system error.
cn: 你迟早会发现隐藏的系统错误。

en: You can go out as long as you finish the task.
cn: 只要你完成任务，你就可以出去。

en: He talks as if he were a professional.
cn: 他说起话来仿佛自己是专业人士。

en: Now that you are here, help us fix the code.
cn: 既然你来了，就帮我们改改代码吧。

en: He woke up early so as to catch the bus.
cn: 他早起以便赶上公共汽车。

en: I can't help laughing at the funny video.
cn: 看到那个搞笑视频我忍不住笑了起来。

m: 无论如何;不管发生什么
en: No matter what happens, keep the system safe.
cn: 无论发生什么，都要确保系统安全。

en: On the other hand, the cost is extremely high.
cn: 另一方面，其成本极其高昂。

en: He is kind as well as clever.
cn: 他既善良又聪明。

en: He speaks not only English but also French.
cn: 他不仅会说英语还会说法语。

en: Either you or your teammate must sign the file.
cn: 要么你，要么你的队友必须在文件上签字。

en: Neither tea nor coffee is fit for his stomach.
cn: 茶和咖啡都不适合他的胃。

en: The trader was heavily in debt.
cn: 那个交易员背负了沉重的债务。

en: At present, the new product is being tested.
cn: 目前，这款新产品正在接受测试。

en: Many cities, for instance, Yokohama, have harbors.
cn: 许多城市，例如横滨，都有港口。

en: By the way, have you seen Jack today?
cn: 顺便问一下，你今天见过杰克吗？

en: Some animals, for example bears, sleep through much of the winter.
cn: 有些动物，例如熊，会在冬季长时间睡眠。

en: In a sense, his decision was right.
cn: 从某种意义上说，他的决定是正确的。

en: The president has been in office for years.
cn: 这位总统已经执政多年了。

en: Don't panic; the fire is under control.
cn: 别慌，火势已经得到控制。

en: The situation was completely out of control.
cn: 局势完全失去了控制。

en: Who is the guard on duty tonight?
cn: 今晚值班的警卫是谁？

en: After going off duty, he went straight home.
cn: 下班后，他直接回家了。

en: It is rude to shout at others in public.
cn: 当众冲别人大喊大叫是粗鲁的。

en: The two managers discussed the matter in private.
cn: 两位经理私下讨论了这件事。

en: I was at a loss when the database crashed suddenly.
cn: 数据库突然崩溃时我不知所措。

en: The country has been at peace for decades.
cn: 这个国家几十年来一直处于和平之中。

en: Regular exercise keeps the athlete in shape.
cn: 规律锻炼使这名运动员保持良好状态。

en: The wooden box was completely out of shape.
cn: 那个木箱已经完全变形了。

en: Above all, keep the logic accurate.
cn: 最重要的是，要保持逻辑的精确。
